I couldn't find the new travel policy, and I've told Dana that in a threaded reply on her message in #north-team.

I searched the knowledge brain, the shared files, and the three channels Dana belongs to where it would most likely appear (#north-team, #general and #help-it-ops). There's no travel policy file, and nobody has posted a link. #general and #help-it-ops have no messages at all.

My reply said someone on the team might have it, and suggested Ruth Calloway "or whoever owns policy docs" could point her to it. That suggestion is only a guess: nothing I found says Ruth owns the travel policy.
